detail.longDescription: Hey With LLMs having infinite attack resources compared to human researchers, how safe are we? We already know that you don't need top tier frontier models to create an attack vector. You can just loop a mid-sized model until it bears result. Or run a small swarm of agents to achieve the same goal How long until a criminal actor with running exo[1] over 2 mac studios breaches password managers? I understand that the storage of passwords might be encrypted, but they might find vulnerabilities at the client or transport level. How may we mitigate this? [1] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49585683
